title: Can Language Models Handle a Non-Gregorian Calendar? The Case of the Japanese wareki

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on temporal reasoning and factual recall using a non-Gregorian calendar (the Japanese wareki) versus the Gregorian calendar, and measuring the tendency of models to default to Gregorian dates (Gregorian bias) even when explicitly prompted for the Japanese calendar format.

Comparing the performance and temporal reasoning capabilities of English-centric versus Japanese-centric language models, and analyzing how the language of the prompt (e.g., presenting historical names in English vs. Japanese) impacts task accuracy.
